WITH sold AS (
  SELECT cp.sku, cp.product_name, cp.category, SUM(f.quantity) AS units_sold, COUNT(*) AS n_lines, COUNT(DISTINCT f.sales_line_id) AS n_distinct_lines
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
  JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku = p.sku AND cp.is_current
  WHERE s.store_id = 102 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-09-27'
  GROUP BY 1,2,3
), ret AS (
  SELECT p.sku, SUM(r.quantity_returned) AS units_returned
  FROM fact_return_line r
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = r.store_key
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
  WHERE s.store_id = 102 AND r.return_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-09-27'
  GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT sd.*, COALESCE(rt.units_returned,0) AS units_returned, sd.units_sold - COALESCE(rt.units_returned,0) AS net_units
FROM sold sd LEFT JOIN ret rt USING (sku)
ORDER BY units_sold DESC, sku LIMIT 10

WITH l AS (
  SELECT f.* FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
  WHERE s.store_id=102 AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-09-27'
)
SELECT 'lines' k, COUNT(*) a, COUNT(DISTINCT sales_line_id) b, SUM(quantity) c, COUNT(DISTINCT sale_date) d, MIN(sale_date) e, MAX(sale_date) f, COUNT(DISTINCT (receipt_id, line_no)) g FROM l
UNION ALL
SELECT 'rpt', COUNT(*), COUNT(DISTINCT business_date), SUM(units_sold), SUM(receipts), MIN(business_date), MAX(business_date), NULL FROM rpt_daily_store_sales WHERE store_id=102 AND business_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-09-27'
